author: Synergic
body: Those two are extremely similar. You try to kill the most people, gain levels for kits, use those kits to kill more people, and prestige. It's really pointless to have both, and whenever I want to play CTH, there is not a single person on. It would be beneficial if CTH and Nexus merged, or CTH was just plain removed.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: Nooo, they are different  Gamemodes.                        In nexus you have to kill the enemy to win and in CTH you have to defend the central point of the map to gain points to win. The half of the forum users say TDM is bad in Nebula, it would be better in nexus. Just because nobody is playing, while you are there, means not, it's not played. Everytime I go on the server, I see that in CTH are at least one server with more than 12 players. Maybe you join an empty server and wait, till the others come. I don't want to see them together, it simply doesn't fit together. (my opinion)
